For Marzipan, the rescue beagle you brought home in July 2025 (an adult beagle, so roughly 9-13 kg / 20-30 lb), a front-clip no-pull harness in size S/M is the best fit - the Ruffwear Front Range, PetSafe Easy Walk, or Blue-9 Balance are all good choices, and a Y-shaped chest strap keeps her shoulders free. Fit it so you can slide two fingers under each strap, clip the leash at the chest ring, and stop walking the moment the leash tightens so pulling never gets rewarded. Given her strong nose-driven pulling, a 1.5-2 m fixed-length leash plus a few sniff breaks per walk will do more than any gear alone.
